description: TRITON Ensemble Simulations for Dam-Break Flood Modeling: Taum Sauk and Sanford Dams is a data set deposited in DOE Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) Repository by its authors Shivakumar Balachandran, Sudershan Gangrade (University of South Carolina). This dataset provides ensemble two-dimensional hydrodynamic simulations of dam-break floods generated using the Two-dimensional Runoff Inundation Toolkit for Operational Needs (TRITON). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
